'''Knossa''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. Located deep within the [[Eocho Mountains/Legends|Eocho Mountains]], the city expanded outward from the [[Eye of Ashlanae/Legends|Eye of Ashlanae]] and served as the center of Jedi culture for nearly twenty thousand years.

{{City-stub}}

==History==
Constructed of stone and ornamented with [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]], the city of Knossa was nestled high in the western [[Eocho Mountains/Legends|Eocho Mountains]], far to the south of the planet's equator. The buildings of the city spread out from a central peak, upon which was constructed the [[Eye of Ashlanae/Legends|Eye of Ashlanae]], an ancient shrine dedicated to those Jedi that were slain during the [[First Great Schism]]. As more and more members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] began pilgrimages to Ashlanae, a large [[Knossa Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was constructed into [[Agorn Mountain/Legends|Agorn Mountain]]. As the city began to grow over the ensuing centuries, eventually the Order established its [[Jedi Praxeum (Ossus)/Legends|Praxeum]] within the city to house and train Jedi visiting Ashlanae. Constantly growing and expanding over the millennia, Knossa eventually came to house a [[Knossa Branch Library/Legends|branch library]] of the remote [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Library]]. Like many cities, Knossa was home to commercial districts, residential buildings, restaurants, and mechanical facilities. Research facilities and laboratories across the city hosted visiting academics and scholars from a host of members worlds of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

The city's central plaza held two important obelisks topped with [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]]. When the two moons of Ossus, [[Mim]] and [[Nerit]], aligned with the crystals, they produced a famous and magnificent display of light. The Jedi held this time to be sacred, and used it to remember those of their Order who had fallen in combat. It is from this that the term [[Ossus Day]] originated.<ref name="geo">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

Like the rest of the planet, the city of Knossa was devastated during the [[Cron Supernova/Legends|Cron Supernova]] that washed across the planet's surface. Citizens of Knossa that had fled into the nearby [[Crystal Caves (Ossus)/Legends|crystal caves]] were able to survive the supernova and emerged to form a tribal society that would come to be known as the [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]].

At some point, the ruins of the city of Knossa were inhabited by many locals. They attempted to restore the city to its once great status.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
